tagline: Missiologist, author, and Founder and CEO of Within Reach Global
letter: Thank you for inviting me into your conversation. I know how much work goes into every episode and every interview, so I put this kit together to make your side of it easy.

For three decades I have lived and served among people who have little or no access to the gospel, first in Southwest China and now in Thailand. I started out carrying Bibles across the border into China, and today I lead a team of local and foreign missionaries through Within Reach Global.

I love telling stories from the field, and I love helping people see where they fit in God's global mission. Inside you will find bios you can read as written, topics I enjoy talking about, questions you are welcome to use, and photos to download.
I am grateful for the chance to talk with you and your audience.
intro: David Joannes is the Founder and CEO of Within Reach Global, a mission organization giving gospel access to unreached people groups in Asia. For three decades he has served in China and Thailand. He is the author of The Mind of a Missionary and the host of the Missions Pulse podcast.
short: David Joannes is the Founder and CEO of Within Reach Global, which gives gospel access to unreached communities in Southeast Asia. He began his missionary journey by smuggling Bibles into China, served for 15 years in Southwest China, and now lives in Chiang Mai, Thailand. David is the author of The Mind of a Missionary, The Space Between Memories, Gospel Privilege, and See the City, and hosts the Missions Pulse podcast. He and his wife, Lorna, have two daughters.
long: David Joannes is the Founder and CEO of Within Reach Global, which serves to give gospel access to unreached communities in the spiritual dead zones of Southeast Asia. Through compassion ministries, evangelism, discipleship, and church planting, the ministry has seen 85 churches planted among hard-to-reach animist, Islamic, atheist, and Buddhist peoples.

David began his missionary journey by smuggling Bibles into China. He has been interrogated for his faith over 20 times and was once apprehended by dozens of child soldiers carrying AK-47s. He has eaten meals with headhunters, shared the gospel with tribal witchdoctors, witnessed secret baptisms, and taught at underground Bible trainings.

After serving for 15 years in Southwest China, David has lived for more than 10 years in Chiang Mai, Thailand, where he oversees a growing team of local and foreign missionaries. He is fluent in Mandarin Chinese and proficient in Tagalog and Thai.

He is the author of The Mind of a Missionary, The Mind of a Missionary Devotional, The Space Between Memories, Gospel Privilege, See the City, and Glorious Hope, and the host of the Missions Pulse podcast. He extends gospel access to unreached peoples with his wife, Lorna, and their two daughters.

wrg: Since 1997, Within Reach Global has brought gospel access to unreached people groups in the 10/40 Window through four areas of work: compassion ministries, evangelism, discipleship, and church planting. Headquartered in Chiang Mai, Thailand, its team of local and foreign missionaries serves communities across Southeast Asia.
podcast: Missions Pulse is David's video podcast about God at work in the world and every believer's role in the Great Commission. Across more than 120 episodes he has interviewed missionaries, authors, and mission leaders.
books: What Global Kingdom Workers Tell Us About Thriving on Mission Today
The Unearned Advantage That's Meant for Everyone
Hope for the Bruised, Battered, and Broken-Hearted
A 31-day devotional inspired by C. T. Studd
topics: From Bible smuggler to mission leader
How a teenager carrying Bibles into China ended up leading a mission organization, and what interrogations, close calls, and three decades on the field have taught him.

What motivates missionaries, what they expect, what they sacrifice, and what rewards they find, drawn from the lives of Jim and Elisabeth Elliot, C. T. Studd, Hudson Taylor, Amy Carmichael, and others.
Gospel privilege and the access gap
Over 2 billion people have yet to hear the name of Jesus. Why access to the gospel is an unearned advantage, and what the Church can do about the imbalance.
How Within Reach Global raises up Thai and Asian missionaries to plant churches among their own neighbors, and why that reaches places outsiders cannot.
Finding your role in the Great Commission
Every believer has a part: pray, give, or go. Practical first steps for listeners, including free tools such as a spiritual gifts test and the Gospel Access Score.
The story of White Flower, a young war refugee from Myanmar, and the hope of the city of God in a world full of suffering.
Raising the next generation for missions
How to stir a heart for the nations in kids and teenagers, and why David created youth and kids editions of his missions course.
questions: You started out smuggling Bibles into China. How did that begin, and what was it like?
You have been interrogated for your faith more than 20 times. What goes through your mind in those moments?
Tell us about the day you were apprehended by dozens of child soldiers.
What does the term "unreached" mean, and why does it still matter today?
You write about "gospel privilege." What is it, and how should it change the way Christians live?
In The Mind of a Missionary you study well-known missionaries. Which one has shaped you the most, and why?
What do people most often misunderstand about missionaries?
Why does Within Reach Global focus on raising up local missionaries?
What does a secret baptism or an underground Bible training look like?
How have you and Lorna raised a family on the mission field for so many years?
What have three decades in Asia taught you about suffering and hope?
Not everyone is called to move overseas. How can an ordinary believer take part in the Great Commission?
What would you say to a young person who senses a call to missions?
How can our listeners pray for you and for Within Reach Global?
